## Executive Summary
Dr. Wasikul Amin Bipu is a registered veterinarian from Bangladesh with specialized training in data analysis, statistical modeling, and visualization using R. He develops interactive dashboards and data tools using R Shiny, Flex-Dashboard, Quarto, and R Markdown, and builds cross-platform mobile and web applications with Flutter and Dart. He also holds multiple honors certifications from top global universities in clinical research, medical writing, public health statistics, and systematic reviews.
